source: FDIC Minority Depository Institutions List — Native American subset
native_identifiability: Federal regulator's roster of Native-owned banks: 20 'Native American or Alaskan Native American' MDIs of 148 total as of 2023-12-31; downloadable Excel/PDF, quarterly (Q1 2026) plus historical 2001-2025 (Attachment-2 list); Minority Banking Opportunity Explorer maps them
identity_semantics: OWNERSHIP designation by a bank regulator, distinct from the CDFI activity test recorded 2026-09-07 -- but the MDI definition has TWO prongs: (a) >=51% voting stock owned by minority individuals, OR (b) a majority-minority board AND a predominantly-minority community served. Prong (b) is NOT an ownership fact. So MDI status corroborates a Native-owned bank only under prong (a); record which prong. Institutions, not a roster of Native businesses
export: downloadable Excel/PDF list (quarterly + historical); FDIC Minority Banking Opportunity Explorer (interactive map)
notes: NEW FRAME: Native-owned banks (the depository layer; complements 09-07 Native CDFIs, which are loan funds/activity-defined). A tribally-owned MDI is also a tribal ENTERPRISE -> crosswalks to the holding-company/NEST layer. Flagship: Native American Bank N.A. (2001, multi-tribally owned; 29 of 35 shareholders are Tribes/Tribal Enterprises/ANCs). The Fed Minneapolis map (already logged 09-07) is a companion. nation_ids: [] (national, mixed tribal + individual ownership).

source: OCC — Banking in Native American Communities resource directory
publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC)
native_identifiability: OCC's directory of Native American banking resources plus 'A Guide to Tribal Ownership of a National Bank' — the national-bank-charter counterpart to the FDIC MDI list, covering the OCC-supervised side
identity_semantics: COVERAGE FRAME / reference: resource directory and chartering guidance, not a business roster. Documents the legal path for a tribe to own a national bank (relevant to how a tribally-owned bank appears as a tribal enterprise), not evidence about any individual business
notes: Companion to the FDIC MDI row on the OCC (national-bank) side; together they cover both charter regimes for Native-owned depository institutions. Reference/coverage-frame, not enumeration. nation_ids: [] (national).
